about: Every walkthrough planned in the build brief (45 iPhone, 50 Windows), with the plain-language summary and alternative phrasings used for search. Folders under /library hold the walkthroughs that have been written so far; their slugs match entries here. varies_by_org marks walkthroughs that depend on an organization's carrier, apps or IT setup.
